description: Numbers of the world lighting and fog. fog_curve: the fog depth curve, 16 bins over the first half of the depth range with linear steps between neighbours (17 values, 0..255). A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.

light.description: Directional light: the weight of an axis is (axis + axis_bias) / axis_span in Q12; sample is the reference falloff the table is scaled from.
